function.name: get_app_state
function.description: Snapshot of everything you can operate: mode (image/video), whether a document is open, canvas size, fps, transport (playhead seconds, playing), tracks, clips, assets, current selection, layer/guidance stacks, staging items, pipeline presets, video-generator interfaces, mask track binding.

function.name: seek
function.description: Move the timeline playhead to `time` seconds.

function.name: play
function.description: Start playback.

function.name: pause
function.description: Pause playback.

function.name: select_clips
function.description: Set the timeline selection to these clip ids (empty array = clear selection). With a single Layer-kind clip and focus=true, also makes it the layer editing target (Layers/Guidances panels switch to its layer set).

focus.description: switch the layer edit target (default true)

function.name: add_track
function.description: Add a timeline track: video | audio | layer | process.

function.name: remove_track
function.description: Remove a track and everything on it.

function.name: rename_track
function.description: Rename a track.

function.name: place_asset
function.description: Place an asset from the project asset table onto the timeline.

function.name: move_clip
function.description: Move a clip to a new start time (and optionally another track). Linked audio/video twins move together unless only_self.

function.name: trim_clip
function.description: Trim a clip edge: edge=in moves the head, edge=out the tail; `time` is the new edge position on the timeline (seconds).

function.name: split_clip
function.description: Split a clip at `time` (timeline seconds) into two.

function.name: remove_clips
function.description: Delete clips from the timeline.

function.name: add_layer_clip
function.description: Create an empty Layer segment (compositing container) on a layer track; creates the track when missing. Editing its layer set = select_clips focus.

function.name: select_layer
function.description: Select a layer row in the workbench (canvas compositing).

function.name: add_layer
function.description: Add a new layer onto a stack: stack=layers|guidances; kind=default|stash.

function.name: create_comic_layout
function.description: Lay out a comic / manga page on the canvas — layout only, no artwork. Creates one empty layer per panel (named Panel N, sized and placed at its page rectangle, ready for layer_generate), an optional paper layer underneath and an optional frame-line layer on top; the whole layout is one undo step. Use it for requests like "漫画格排版 / 分镜排版 / panel grid / comic page layout". rows/cols (+ optional row_weights / col_weights) make a regular grid; `panels` with explicit px rectangles makes an irregular page. Omit w/h to keep the current canvas; when they differ the canvas is resized first.

row_weights.description: relative row heights, one per row (default equal)

col_weights.description: relative column widths, one per column (default equal)

margin.description: page margin px (default ~4% of the short side)

gutter.description: gap between panels px (default ~3% of the short side)

border.description: panel frame line width px; 0 = no frame layer (default 3)

paper.description: paper colour #rrggbb, or "none" for a transparent page (default #ffffff)

panels.description: explicit panel rectangles in page px (overrides rows/cols) — use for irregular pages

function.name: remove_layer
function.description: Remove a layer row.

function.name: duplicate_layer
function.description: Duplicate a layer row.

function.name: rename_layer
function.description: Rename a layer row.

function.name: set_layer_opacity
function.description: Set a layer overall opacity 0..1.

function.name: toggle_layer_visibility
function.description: Toggle a layer eye.

function.name: layer_generate
function.description: Run the layer Generate (image generation) on a layer row.

function.name: layer_from_asset
function.description: Insert a repo asset (content hash) as a new layer image.

function.name: set_extra_prompt
function.description: Set the Extra Prompt text used by Blend / Tag runs.

function.name: run_blend
function.description: Start a Blend run (canvas -> processed result into staging).

function.name: run_tag
function.description: Start a Tag run (annotate the canvas).

function.name: run_pipeline
function.description: Run a pipeline preset on the active document (the workbench main run). Omit preset_id to use the active preset.

function.name: cancel_run
function.description: Cancel the currently running generation.

function.name: set_canvas_size
function.description: Resize the canvas (pixels).

function.name: undo
function.description: Undo the last edit (works in both image and video mode).

function.name: redo
function.description: Redo an undone edit.

function.name: view_fit
function.description: Fit the canvas view (zoom to content).

function.name: set_fps
function.description: Set the video project output frame rate.

function.name: set_paint_color
function.description: Set the painting foreground color (#rrggbb).

function.name: set_brush
function.description: Configure the brush.

function.name: add_vgen_segment
function.description: Add a Video Generator segment for interface #interface_index onto the process track (opens its prompt card for the user to fill).

function.name: add_continue_segment
function.description: Like add_vgen_segment but seeds the new segment with the last frame of the currently selected video segment (continuation).

function.name: document
function.description: Document actions. new = blank document in its own window; load = pick a .cud (native open dialog — the user finishes it); save = silent when the file path is known, otherwise a native Save dialog; save-as = always asks where; export-png = write the composite (visible layers, no guidances) as a PNG; import = pick images/PSD as new layers (native dialog); close = close the active document.

function.name: get_prompt_state
function.description: [SELECTION read] Read the Prompt tab's CURRENT SELECTION (the prompt_node iframe): the free-text custom prompt, selected prompt cards (with ids + display text), LoRAs (name/strength/active), prefabs and programs. Does NOT touch the library. Call this before editing so you act on the live selection, not a stale guess.

function.name: prompt_library
function.description: [DISCOVERY, read-only] List the prompt-card library so you can discover card ids/names to reference in set_prompt / prompt_card_*. Changes nothing — neither creates nor selects. Optional category filters to one category.

function.name: set_prompt
function.description: [SELECTION edit] Edit the Prompt tab SELECTION only (what feeds generation). This does NOT create or save any library item — it composes the active selection from EXISTING library items. Each optional field replaces that part of the selection. custom_prompt = free text; prompts = list of {id} / {category,name} / {category,prompt} / {text}, applied per prompt_mode (replace|add|remove, default replace); loras = list of {name|file_path, strength?, active?}; prefabs = list of {guid, active?}; programs = list of {id, active?}. The change is applied in the Prompt tab AND persisted to the prompt server the detailer reads. Unresolvable items are reported in warnings, not dropped.

prompt_mode.description: how prompts list is applied (default replace)

prompts.description: prompt cards to set/add/remove; each {id} or {category,name} or {category,prompt} or {text}

function.name: prompt_card_add
function.description: [LIBRARY add] Create a NEW prompt card in the library (the category is created if missing). Library write only — this does NOT select the card; call set_prompt afterward to include it in the active prompt. Returns the new card id.

function.name: prompt_card_update
function.description: [LIBRARY edit] Edit an existing prompt card in the library by id: change its name/prompt/category/tags/natural. Library write only — does NOT change the current selection.

function.name: prompt_card_delete
function.description: [LIBRARY delete] Delete a prompt card from the library by id. Library delete only — does NOT touch the selection.

function.name: lora_library
function.description: [DISCOVERY, read-only] List every LoRA available in the Prompt tab library (from loraData): each entry gives file_path, name and tags. Use this to discover the file_path/name to reference in set_prompt's loras field. Changes nothing — neither creates nor selects.

function.name: prefab_library
function.description: [DISCOVERY, read-only] List every prefab available in the Prompt tab library (from allLibraries): each entry gives guid, name, the tag_groups/loras/custom_prompts it applies, and the library name. Use this to discover the guid (and library name for prefab_add) to reference in set_prompt's prefabs field. Changes nothing — neither creates nor selects.

function.name: program_library
function.description: [DISCOVERY, read-only] List every program available in the Prompt tab library: each entry gives id and name. Use this to discover the id to reference in set_prompt's programs field. Changes nothing — neither creates nor selects.

function.name: prefab_add
function.description: [LIBRARY add] Add a NEW prefab to a prefab library. Requires library (a name from prefab_library's libraries list) and name. Optional tag_groups (list), loras (list), custom_prompts (string), selected_prefabs (list) and image (base64 data URL). Library write only — does NOT select the new prefab; call set_prompt afterward to include it in the active prompt. Returns the new guid.

function.name: prefab_update
function.description: [LIBRARY edit] Update an existing prefab in the library by guid (from prefab_library). Only the provided fields change: name, tag_groups, loras, custom_prompts, selected_prefabs, image (base64). Located by guid across all libraries. Library write only — does NOT change the current selection.

function.name: prefab_delete
function.description: [LIBRARY delete] Delete a prefab from the library by guid (from prefab_library). Library delete only — does NOT touch the selection. Returns ok.

function.name: program_add
function.description: [LIBRARY add] Add a NEW program to a program category. Requires name. Optional code, category (defaults to "Applications"), image (base64), selected_programs, multi_program, enable_*_context flags, context_*_guids/paths/texts and *_builtin_* arrays. Library write only — does NOT select the new program; call set_prompt afterward to include it in the active prompt. Returns the new id.

function.name: program_update
function.description: [LIBRARY edit] Update an existing program in the library by id (from program_library). Only the provided fields change (name, code, image, video, selected_programs, multi_program, enable_*_context, context_* and *_builtin_* arrays). Located by id across all categories. Library write only — does NOT change the current selection.

function.name: program_delete
function.description: [LIBRARY delete] Delete a program from the library by id (from program_library). Library delete only — does NOT touch the selection. Returns ok.

function.name: lora_refresh
function.description: [LIBRARY scan] Rescan the lora folders on disk so newly added .safetensors/.metadata.json files appear in lora_library. Call this after new lora files are dropped into the folder. Returns ok with the new lora count. Read-only scan (LoRAs are files, so there is no add/delete); does NOT change the current selection.

function.name: lora_update
function.description: [LIBRARY/asset edit] Edit a LoRA's slider config (LoRAs are files, so there is no add/delete). Currently supports model_only (boolean): when true the lora patches the model only, not CLIP. Identify the lora by file_path or fingerprint. Asset edit only — does NOT change the current selection.

function.name: get_ui_actions
function.description: [DISCOVERY, read-only] List the workbench UI action keys you can fire with ui_action. Each entry: action (the key), kind (none|string|number|boolean|array|object), payload (the TS type of the value), doc (what it does). Every button, slider and menu item in the workbench is one of these. Filter by `group` (action prefix: layer/fx/attr/paint/brush/view/mask/staging/processor/... ) or by a keyword in `q`. Changes nothing.

group.description: only actions whose key starts with this prefix

q.description: only actions whose key/doc contains this text

function.name: ui_action
function.description: [UI] Fire a workbench UI action — exactly what the matching button / slider / menu item does. `action` must be a key from get_ui_actions (unknown keys are rejected, not silently ignored). `value` is that key's payload: omit it for kind=none, pass the bare value for kind=string|number|boolean|array, pass an object for kind=object (field names are in the payload type). Prefer a dedicated tool when one exists (seek, add_layer, prompt_*, ...) — those validate more and say more in the result; use ui_action for everything else. Read get_app_state first when the action depends on ids (layers, clips, assets).

function.name: set_timeline_zoom
function.description: Set the timeline zoom level (pixels per second).

function.name: toggle_track_mute
function.description: Toggle mute on a track (video/audio/layer each have their own meaning).

function.name: toggle_track_solo
function.description: Toggle solo on a track: an audio track solos audio, a video track solos video; layer tracks do not take solo.

function.name: move_track
function.description: Reorder a track by index (array order = top-to-bottom order, which is compositing order for video tracks).

function.name: set_mask_track
function.description: Bind the mask track to a video track (or clear it with track_id=null).

function.name: toggle_vgen_chain
function.description: Link / unlink two Video Generator segments at their seam (what Ctrl+click on the seam does): the second segment then takes the first one's last frame. Needs same track, both generator segments, touching start/end, and the second one binding first_frame. Already linked to `prev` ⇒ unlinks.
